STEP 6. Check the harness wires between trunk lid latch 
switch connector F-16 and ETACS-ECU connector C-112.
NOTE: After checking intermediate connector C-90, check the 
wires. If intermediate connector C-90 is damaged, repair or 
replace it. Refer to GROUP 00E, Harness Connector 
Inspection P.00E-2.
Q: Are the harness wires between trunk lid latch switch 
connector F-16 and ETACS-ECU connector C-112 in 
good condition?
YES : Replace the ETACS-ECU. The input signal from the 
trunk lid latch switch should be able to be checked 
and the functions, which are described in the 
"Technical Description (comment)," should work 
normally.
NO : Repair them. The input signal from the trunk lid latch 
switch should be able to be checked and the 
functions, which are described in the "Technical 
Description (comment)," should work normally.
